message.content:
The margin table shows gain (s21_db) as the binding constraint, so I add a cascode-style tank load by keeping the degenerated CS core and swapping the tapped-C load for an LC tank on the drain, which raises the load impedance at resonance and lifts gain while leaving the input match largely intact. I expect s21_db to improve by a few dB with nf_db roughly flat and idd_ma unchanged.

```netlist
# degenerated CS with LC-tank load (edit: raise gain)
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n4 n2 n3 VSS
L Ls n3 VSS
L Ld VDD n4
C Ct1 n4 VSS
C Cout n4 VOUT1
```

```json
{"predicted_deltas": {"s21_db": 2.5, "nf_db": 0.0, "s11_db": 0.0, "idd_ma": 0.0}}
```
